label: WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_5: the respect of being, a frame field
term: esse, the respect of being in the perfection frame
definition: `CausalityFrame.esse`: the distinguished respect of being. `InAct x esse` says that x has being; maximal in being and cause of being are said with respect to it (DEF-ESSE). It is a respect, an element of the respect carrier, not a predicate of world-relative existence (`Ontic.ExistsAt`, WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_1), not external support and not a root predicate: the passages from InAct x esse to existence at a world are explicit bridge premises.
note: Stipulative frame-field record, attribution deferred; its content is DEF-ESSE (sourced, ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3). It is a separate record because DEF-ESSE is linked by about 400 arguments, many of which also link DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL and pass between the two through explicit bridges; making DEF-ESSE itself a sense would turn those into unbridged mixing. The existence fork that DISAMB-EXISTENCE-ESSE-SUPPORT asks for (DEF-KANT-ONTOLOGICAL-MODEL against DEF-ESSE) remains a follow-up. Introduced with the grades frame module (TruthCore/Causality/GradesFrame.lean) after the truth discover diagnosis of 2026-11-20.

formal_gap.meaning: CausalityFrame.esse is one element of the respect carrier R, the respect in which a thing is said to have being. A frame supplies it; nothing in the type distinguishes it from other respects or relates it to the history's world-relative existence.
examples: InAct x esse for a fire that exists, as against InAct x hot for its heat.
CausesIn c x esse: c causes x's being, not merely its coming to be (DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION).
exclusions: World-relative existence (history.ontic ExistsAt): related to InAct x esse only by explicit bridges such as the act-of-esse premises.
A perfection other than being, such as goodness or truth: identifying esse with another respect is a substantive premise (for example the convertibility readings).
open_obligations: That nothing has actuality except insofar as it is (ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading) is an open source premise, not part of the field.
Whether being admits of more and less across categories (MoreIn esse) is carried by the grades premises, not by this field (DISAMB-BEING).
